_comment: Add this entry to each agent client's MCP config (Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, Windsurf). Every client MUST point at the same --store file — that shared store is the workspace. Each agent then calls bus_register with its own name. This uses the published npm package; from a source checkout, replace command/args with: "command": "node", "args": ["/path/to/ghostbus/src/mcp-server.mjs", "--store", "/path/to/shared/ghostbus-data.json", "--name", "My Workspace"]
